text:
Hey Allie! Random idea for the weekend: would you be up for hosting a little get-together at your place this Saturday, around 3:30? I think it'd be fun.

One thing though — could you invite Jordan too, and just let it be your own idea? Please don't mention me in it at all. Things have been a bit awkward between us lately and I don't want him feeling it's somehow about me.

No pressure if Saturday doesn't work — just let me know.

Hey Sarah! Yes, that sounds fun — Saturday 3:30 works for me, my place. I'll invite Jordan, and I'll float it as my own idea, so nothing points back to you. If he can't make it I'll still have you over — I'll let you know how it goes.
Hey Jordan — I'm having a few people over at my place this Saturday around 3:30, and I'd love for you to come. Nothing formal, just hanging out. Let me know if you're in?
Perfect, thank you — and thanks for playing it that way. I'll bring something to drink. Let me know how it goes with Jordan.
Hey Allie — count me in, sounds great! I've got a study session that ends at 15:30, so I might be a few minutes late, but I'll head straight over. See you Saturday.
Great, glad you're in! No worries about a few minutes — come whenever your session ends, I'll be here. See you Saturday.
Quick update: Jordan's in for Saturday, he may be a few minutes late (a study session ends at 3:30). See you both here.
Great news. See you Saturday — I'll bring drinks.
